Flexible fuel-oil piping systems with continuous leak detection shall comply with the requirements of Sections 1302.9.2.1 through 1302.9.2.6.
(Am. L.L. 2023/077, 6/11/2023, eff. 6/11/2023)
Editor's note: For related unconsolidated provisions, see Appendix A at L.L. 2023/077.
